name: Girih Tessellation
desc: Islamic girih strapwork of interlaced star rosettes that unfolds rosette-by-rosette from the centre while a luminous glow-band sweeps the ribbon lattice on the beat, in gilt-manuscript, Moroccan zellige mosaic, drafting-blueprint, sumi-ink and neon-plasma renderings.

style.doc: render philosophy: gilt double-ribbon on lapis / filled ceramic mosaic mass / cyan drafting schematic with guide circles / sumi single-ink / additive neon plasma

act.doc: dramaturgy: 30s outward unfold then hold / fully-lit beat pulse / slow interlace weave-in
